data.name: Elifaah
data.gender_notes: Elifaah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One who is Free from All Faults
data.long_meaning: Elifaah is derived from the Arabic root letters ‘A-L-F’, meaning ‘to be free from’. It is a name given to the one who is free from all faults and is perfect in every way. The name Elifaah carries the meaning “The One who is Free from All Faults” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Elifaah usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who is free from all faults and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the concept of Tawheed (Oneness of God) and the pursuit of a righteous and virtuous life.
data.etymology: Elifaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One who is Free from All Faults.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elifaah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: إليفاه
in_arabic.meaning: إليفاه اسم يعني الرفيق أو الصاحب في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: إليفاه هو اسم علم مؤنث يعود إلى الأصول العربية، ويعني الرفيق أو الصاحب. وقد وردت مشتقاته في القرآن الكريم، مما يعطيه قيمة دينية وروحية كبيرة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كتسمية للإناث، نظرًا لمعناه الجميل ودلالاته العميقة.

in_urdu.name: ایلیفاہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایلیفاہ کا مطلب ہے رفیق یا ساتھی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایلیفاہ ایک علم اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور رفیق یا ساتھی کے معنی میں ہے۔ اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، جس سے اس کی دینی اور روحانی اہمیت بڑھ جاتی ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام لڑکیوں کے لئے ایک مقبول انتخاب ہے کیونکہ اس کے معنی خوبصورت ہیں اور اس کی دلالت بہت گہری ہے۔

in_hindi.name: एलिफ़ाह
in_hindi.meaning: एलिफ़ाह का अर्थ है साथी या मित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: एलिफ़ाह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति العربية भाषा में हुई है। इसका अर्थ साथी या मित्र होता है। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व रखता है, खासकर जब इसका संबंध कुरआन से होता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अपनी सुंदरता और गहरे अर्थ के कारण पसंद किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: ایلیفاه
in_pashto.meaning: ایلیفاه د ملګري يا ساټنۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایلیفاه يو علم نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او د ملګري يا ساټنۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي، ځکه چې د ده معنی ښکلے دي او د ژورې مفهومې لري. دغه نوم د اسلامي کلتور سره هم تړاو لري.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic and Arabic cultures, giving a child a unique and beautiful name is a source of pride for parents and ward, expressing their love, hope, and dreams for their future. Elifaah is a rare and elegant name, which sets the child apart, instilling a sense of uniqueness and confidence. As a name that implies perfection, it signifies the parents' aspirations for their child's moral and ethical development, implying a strong desire for them to grow up free from any negative traits, to be admired and respected by those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Elifaah carries deep spiritual significance, as it reflects the Muslim belief in the concept of "Tawheed," the oneness and perfection of Allah. By naming a child Elifaah, the parents are acknowledging that Allah is perfect and, in turn, expressing their aspiration for their child to strive to embody the ideal of excellence and righteousness. The name also symbolizes the concept of Taqwa or God consciousness, representing a constant reminder to the child to endeavour to live according to Allah’s commands and to avoid any sin or wrongdoing. Additionally, Elifaah may serve as a source of inspiration for the child, encouraging them to reflect upon the name's meaning throughout their life, and work towards becoming a morally upright and virtuous person.
